messages:
Zoe H.: noticed strict fncall validator canary flagged ~3.1% validation_failed and were routing to fallback, which doubles token billing for same user call.
Sam R.: can you paste a minimal example?
Zoe H.: log excerpt: `tool_response: "{\"output\": "[]"}"` expected object for 'output' but got string -> validation_failed.
Mark D.: current flow re-runs on fallback; that second call is billed separately. product wants explicit UX (either primary-with-warning or clear fallback).
Zoe H.: proposal: emit header `X-Validation-Outcome: soft-warning|hard-fail|routed|ok` so billing can attribute retries. add metric `validation.v1.reject_rate` + reason dimension (type_mismatch, missing_field, malformed_json).
Sam R.: telemetry + infra OK, but billing needs a contract and backfill rules. billing-bot: Billing can honor `X-Validation-Outcome: soft-warning` to zero-out retry charges if RFC signed and service id matches validator.
Mark D.: console UX: show small "Schema warning" badge on invocation detail and link to sampled raw payload (PII-scrubbed). add admin toggle: "Treat validation failures as warnings".
Zoe H.: rollout plan: 1) metrics only, 2) add badge + sampling, 3) soft-warning on 1% traffic, 4) expand to 10% after 48h if stable, 5) enable billing rule after cross-team sign-off.
Sam R.: add trace tag `validation.strict=true` and sample rate per-reason (canary 100%, prod default 1%). store samples encrypted in s3 with hashed user id.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for validator v1.2 (slice: beta). :rocket:
Zoe H.: alert rule: pause canary if validation.v1.reject_rate > 3% for 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary paused automatically (validation.v1.reject_rate = 3.6%). ref: alert#val-1212.
Sam R.: rolling back v1.2, will open RFC for header contract and invite Billing + Support.
Mark D.: will draft console copy for the badge and admin toggle.
Zoe H.: thanks — assigning owners: Zoe (validator), Sam (telemetry), Mark (console), Billing team. will follow up with PRs and invites.
